scope: Basic Day 7; English questions match the English corpus.
split_policy: Dev answers use Units 1-4; test answers use distinct Unit 5 topics. Test is authored and frozen before retrieval runs.
provenance: 15 Day 6 dev questions reused with exact raw evidence; no Day 6 test question is reused.

review.method: All 20 answerable cases checked against PDF text; rendered pages 50-52 also inspected for table layout. Four absence checks search all 53 indexed pages and inspect relevant sections.

retrieval.filter_policy: Only explicit Unit scope, shared unchanged by all methods.

hit_rule: One result must match source_id/page and contain a complete listed evidence quote. Gold entries are alternatives, not multi-hop requirements.
context_metric: Packed-context evidence preview only; final agent context is not evaluated yet.
error_policy: Keep every question and error in traces. Answerable errors remain in retrieval metric denominators.
selection_status: Not selected; retrieval comparison is not final agent configuration selection.
